sentences.en: My husband has five or six brains which are remarkably irrigated.
sentences.zh: 我的丈夫有五六个大脑，而且血液供应得非常好。

sentences.en: Remarkably it disappeared within the blink of an eye.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，它眨眼间就消失了。

sentences.en: Algeria is remarkably similar to its neighbor Tunisia in many ways.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，阿尔及利亚与邻国突尼斯非常相似。

senses.zh: 引人注目地;明显地;非常地
